title: Construct supercell model
action: Build the 6Z-SiCNR supercell with width 6, H-terminated edges, and vacuum layers as described in the method. Generate a geometry file pristine.xyz containing the atomic coordinates.
description: Generate the atomic structure of the pristine zigzag SiC nanoribbon.

title: DFT for pristine nanoribbon
action: Run spin-polarized DFT relaxation and electronic structure calculation for pristine 6Z-SiCNR. Compute total magnetic moment via Mulliken analysis and band gaps from band structure. Save the DFT output log as pristine.log.
description: Calculate reference magnetic and electronic properties of the defect-free system.

title: DFT for single Si vacancy
action: Remove the Si atom at site 1 from the pristine supercell, relax the structure, and run DFT to obtain total magnetic moment and band gaps. Save the output log as vsi.log.
description: Investigate metallic and magnetic properties induced by a single silicon vacancy.

title: DFT for single C vacancy
action: Remove the C atom at site 7 from the pristine supercell, relax, and run DFT to obtain total magnetic moment and band gaps. Save the output log as vc.log.
description: Investigate the half-metal to metal transition induced by a single carbon vacancy.

title: DFT for double Si vacancies (V_Si^1 V_Si^4)
action: Remove Si atoms at sites 1 and 4 from the pristine supercell, relax, and run DFT to obtain total magnetic moment and band gaps. Save the output log as vsivsi4.log.
description: Study the semiconducting character and magnetism of the double Si vacancy configuration.

title: DFT for Si+C divacancy (V_Si^1 V_C^8)
action: Remove Si at site 1 and C at site 8 from the pristine supercell, relax, and run DFT to obtain total magnetic moment and band gaps. Save the output log as vsivc8.log.
description: Investigate the interplay of silicon and carbon vacancies, including bond reconstruction and oscillatory magnetism.

title: DFT for V_Si with B substitution (V_Si^1 B_Si^4)
action: Create a Si vacancy at site 1 and substitute a B atom at the vacant Si site 4, relax, and run DFT to obtain total magnetic moment and band gaps. Save the output log as vsibsi4.log.
description: Assess the effect of B filling a Si vacancy, which saturates dangling bonds and preserves semiconducting character.

title: DFT for V_Si with N substitution (V_Si^1 N_C^8)
action: Create a Si vacancy at site 1 and substitute an N atom at the vacant C site 8, relax, and run DFT to obtain total magnetic moment and band gaps. Save the output log as vsinc8.log.
description: Investigate how N doping at a vacant C site suppresses oscillatory magnetism and restores half-metallic character.

title: Compile results into CSV
action: From the DFT output logs, extract for each of the seven systems (pristine, V_Si, V_C, V_Si^1V_Si^4, V_Si^1V_C^8, V_Si^1B_Si^4, V_Si^1N_C^8) the total magnetic moment (μB) from Mulliken analysis and the spin-up/spin-down band gaps (eV). For metallic systems where a band gap is not defined, use NaN. Write a CSV file computed_results.csv with columns: system, total_magnetic_moment, spin_up_gap, spin_down_gap.
description: Scored output: total magnetic moments and band gaps for six defect configurations plus the V_Si+N system.
output_schema: columns: system (string), total_magnetic_moment (float, μB), spin_up_gap (float, eV), spin_down_gap (float, eV)
